title: Rusty Chisel
body:
"Used for slicing refined and forged ores into pieces, and can shave your rocks to fit them into smaller processors."

Description

Rusty Chisel is a chisel new players recieve while going through the tutorial. It's the worst chisel in the game, being also sold on the shelf by the entrance of The Oak Depot for $727.

Chisels are tools used to slice refined and forged ores into pieces and shave rocks to fit into processors. Do note, that shaving will reduce yield of the ore/rock, so it's advised to save them to be processed in a bigger machine later

Appearance

Rusty Chisel, like the name implies, is a typical looking chisel with noticeable signs of corrosion present on it's blade. It's handle is made out of the same wood other rusty tools use for their handles.

Blade is gray in color with the default legacy rust material applied to it. Handle is using a brown yellowish coloring, having the default legacy wood material applied.

Trivia

  • Chisels are the only tools that do not have their stats listed in their descriptions, probably due to to the fact different tiers of chisels only vary in speed they can slice/shave an ore.
  • For one update, Rusty Chisel, Rusty Refinery, Rusty Axe and Rusty Pickaxe were found in the basement of The Oak Depot. This was changed due to players getting confused.
